# Pakistani Open-Source Developers and Organizations

A community-maintained directory of Pakistani open-source developers, GitHub contributors, software organizations, communities, and events.

- Canonical directory: https://usman2x.github.io/awesome-pakistani/
- Source repository: https://github.com/usman2x/awesome-pakistani
- JSON dataset: https://usman2x.github.io/awesome-pakistani/data/awesome-pakistani.json
- JSON Schema: https://usman2x.github.io/awesome-pakistani/awesome-data.schema.json
- Citation metadata: https://github.com/usman2x/awesome-pakistani/blob/master/CITATION.cff
- Last updated: 2026-08-06
